name: 2DMD - Layered Molecular Dynamics
description: Layered molecular dynamics of 2D materials: up to six sheets of graphene, hBN and transition-metal dichalcogenides (and a Mo/W telluride alloy), each with its own size, offset and twist, on a substrate. Gas pockets in any gap, protrusions, local heating, an energy minimiser, H-terminated edges, and a LAMMPS deck exporter. Fast built-in engine, or LAMMPS (AIREBO, ExTeP, REBO-MoS2, Stillinger-Weber) in builds that link it.
